catalogue.name: The Primary Chambers
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Doctrine
sharedRules.description:
Primary Chamber units may only use Primary Chamber transports.

Spend one (1) Faction point:
● Mag-mod weaponry: use when activating a regular non-command unit. This unit may switch option.
● Double time: use when activating a regular unit. It gets Move and Fire until end of turn.
● Heritage: You may also select 1 faction power from any Chambers doctrine and use it during the game.

sharedRules.name: Hunters must be patient
sharedRules.description: Use when determining initiative. If you would have it, your opponent gets it instead. Alternatively, use it as the “Snatch the Initiative” FP option, but retain your FP on 5+.

sharedRules.name: Shellgame tactics
sharedRules.description: Use when you have initiative. One (1) friendly unit within 18” of a friendly board edge and more than 12” from enemy units is removed and placed within 12” of a friendly board edge and more than 12” from enemy units.

sharedRules.name: We have a list
sharedRules.description: All attacks versus one (1) enemy unit has loathing until end of game.

sharedRules.name: Always Forward!
sharedRules.description: Use before game. One (1) friendly Chamber Squad OR Assault Squad gets Vanguard.

sharedRules.name: Furious Charge
sharedRules.description: One (1) friendly unit gets Charge(3) for one (1) attack.

sharedRules.name: Rage
sharedRules.description: Use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: Shield of Defiance
sharedRules.description: Use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a friendly regular unit. It has Defence(re-roll) for this attack.

sharedRules.name: Seize the initiative
sharedRules.description: Use when determining initiative. If your opponent would get it, you get it instead. Alternatively, use it as the “Snatch the Initiative” FP option, but retain your FP on 5+.

sharedRules.name: Tactical Mastery
sharedRules.description: Use when an enemy unit deploys onto the board with insertion or Ambush. It receives one (1) action marker.

sharedRules.name: EMP Mine
sharedRules.description: After this unit deploys with Infiltrate, place an EMP mine token within 12” at least 6" from any enemy. The first enemy vehicle that moves within 6” of the mine rolls on the vehicle damage table with -3.

sharedRules.name: Automated defensive weaponry
sharedRules.description: Model has 1x Rocket pod and may use it as a free priority action/reaction.

sharedRules.name: AA director
sharedRules.description: Light Autocannon, HMG, Hicap Primary Autocannon OR Primary Gatling cannon has antiair.

sharedRules.name: Greyport Armoury
sharedRules.description:
Unoffical Units and Weapon Options
- Mech additonal weapon options

sharedRules.name: Martyr(scouts, +1 FP)
sharedRules.description: When this unit's scouts is removed as a casualty, +1 FP.

sharedRules.name: Sacrifice(ignore 1 dangerous terrain test)
sharedRules.description: You may remove one scout to ignore 1 dangerous terrain test.

sharedRules.name: Bionic enhancement
sharedRules.description: All friendly unarmed regular units get CC (2) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Machine endurance
sharedRules.description: Use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a friendly Massive or Vehicle unit. It has Defence(re-roll) for this attack.

sharedRules.name: Target priority
sharedRules.description: All regular model attacks versus one (1) enemy unit have Masterwork until end of game.

sharedRules.name: Deploy tanglers
sharedRules.description: Use when a CC attack is made vs a friendly unit. It gets Repel(2) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Rapid reactions
sharedRules.description: Use when a regular unit makes a ranged reaction attack. It gets First Strike.

sharedRules.name: Target-appropriate ammunition
sharedRules.description: Use before a regular unit makes a ranged attack vs a non-vehicle target. It gets wound(re-roll).
